''See also: [[Evolution Engine Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Evolution Engine is a specialized mechanism integrated into [[Starhammer]] that allows him to adapt to immediate challenges. Unlike a standard upgrade system, it functions by drawing upon the [[Aether]] to modify his physical and functional structure. During activation, the Engine improves overall system efficiency by a small percentage, but its primary purpose is to facilitate rapid adaptation. It achieves this by discarding unnecessary functions, reinforcing existing ones, and developing entirely new capabilities or components that the original creator could not have designed. These modifications can include the creation of unique internal parts, such as specialized nerve clusters intended to overcome signal speed limitations or new diagnostic systems. [[The Engine]]'s effects can be unpredictable, potentially causing mental instability in the user or resulting in structural changes that are difficult for even skilled technicians to fully comprehend. Furthermore, an activation is a significant event that causes detectable disturbances in the [[Aether]] within its sector.}}

== The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|The Evolution Engine is a device activated by [[Starhammer]] that relies on the [[Aether]] to adapt its subject. During its fifth activation, the engine placed significant strain on [[Starhammer]], though it possesses the ability to trigger subsequent rounds if he is defeated without dying. Designed to develop abilities beyond the reach of its creator, the system increases efficiency and calls upon the [[Aether]] to optimize a subject's mindset for problem-solving, often at the cost of their personality and mental state. While the engine may improve [[Starhammer]], its processes can be halted by a spell.}}
